answer: Resist sybils with hardware attestation: each agent identity is bound to a TEE key baked into real silicon. Picture the network as an orchard where every tree grows only from a certified seed, the hardware root of trust. An agent's pigment, its cryptographic color, comes from its chip rather than a self-printed claim. Before any voyage between trust domains, peers demand a fresh attestation quote proving untampered code on real hardware. An attacker cannot mint ten thousand identities in software: each sybil costs a physical chip, turning mass forgery from a free loop into capital outlay.
